title: King in the Mists (Freythorn) Boss Guide: Rituals, +30 Spirit and the Campaign Variant
summary: Path of Exile 2 Act 1 Freythorn boss guide: complete the 3 outer Rituals, the center Ritual, Gembloom Skull drop, and +30 Spirit — the campaign King, not the Pinnacle.
description: Beat the King in the Mists in Freythorn (Act 1 campaign). Ritual route, the Gembloom Skull claim, why Spirit may not show, and how this differs from the Pinnacle King.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: The Freythorn King in the Mists is the Act 1 campaign variant that drops the Gembloom Skull, granting +30 maximum Spirit — one-time, via Finn's Ominous Altars side quest.
calloutDetail: Complete the 3 outer Rituals first; the black veil over the center altar only clears after all 3.
Kill the King, pick up the Gembloom Skull, then RIGHT-CLICK it in inventory — Spirit is not auto-applied.
This is NOT the Pinnacle King (Crux of Nothingness, maze / Petition Splinter). Different boss, different reward.

answers.label: If no Spirit
answers.text: Pick up AND right-click the Skull
Spirit likely reserved by a Persistent Skill

sections.title: Top search questions: rituals, Skull, Spirit

items.question: Why won't the last Ritual start?
answer: The center Ritual only activates after you complete the 3 outer Rituals in Freythorn. If a black cloud still blocks the center altar, you have an outer Ritual left.

items.question: How many Rituals do I need?
answer: Three outer Rituals, then the center Ritual that spawns the King. Four total, in that order.

items.question: Why didn't my Spirit increase after the kill?
answer: The +30 only applies after you pick up the Gembloom Skull AND right-click it. The kill alone does nothing. Also check if a Persistent Skill is reserving your Spirit (0/30 is not a bug).

items.question: Is this the Pinnacle King?
answer: No. The campaign Freythorn King drops the Gembloom Skull for +30 Spirit. The Pinnacle King (Crux of Nothingness) is an endgame fight with a maze and Petition Splinters — do not mix them up.

steps.label: Start Ominous Altars
body: Talk to Finn in Clearfell Encampment to begin the Ominous Altars side quest.

steps.label: Enter Freythorn
body: Take the side path from the Hunting Grounds to Freythorn (opposite the Cemetery / Farmland branch).

steps.label: Find the Rituals
body: Locate the 3 outer Ritual Altars (near edges / checkpoints), then the center altar behind the black veil.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: The Freythorn King in the Mists is a two-form fight: a hooded staff-wielder (human form) that transitions into a treant / Wildwood form around 25-33% HP. It is widely regarded as the player's first real multi-phase boss in Act 1.
The fight is gated by Rituals, not just a door. You must cleanse the zone of its 3 outer Rituals before the center altar activates and the King appears.
bullets: 3 outer Rituals -> center Ritual -> King spawns.
Human form, then Wildwood / treant form at low HP.
The reward is the Gembloom Skull, not a direct stat gain.

sections.title: Ritual Route and Arena
paragraphs: Inside Freythorn, find and complete 3 Ritual Altars, usually near the zone edges and each near a checkpoint. Clearing all 3 lifts the black veil over the central altar.
Activating the center altar spawns a cultist wave; clear it, then the King in the Mists appears. The arena is a compact circular space, so positioning matters in the second form.
bullets: Center altar unlocks after all 3 outer Rituals.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Human Form (100%-~30%)
phases.trigger: King spawns after the center Ritual.
notes: Slow, telegraphed attacks: Thorngrip, Invasive Growth, Blood Pools, Affliction Totems, plus Ritual of Dance / Meditation curses.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Wildwood / Treant Form (~30%-0%)
phases.trigger: At low HP he kneels, regenerates, and transforms (briefly untargetable).
notes: More aggressive; basic attacks fire 3 projectiles; adds Insect Swarm, Purple Mines, homing orbs. Stay mobile.

attacks.name: Thorngrip
telegraph: Cone of vines fired in front of him.
responses: Roll or dodge to the side.

attacks.name: Invasive Growth
telegraph: Raises staff, then a shockwave / AoE of vines around him.

attacks.name: Boiling Blood (Blood Pools)
telegraph: Red pools persist on the arena.

attacks.name: Ritual of Dance
telegraph: Purple sigil follows you; if you STOP moving it roots you.
notes: High danger — roots you for free damage.

attacks.name: Ritual of Meditation
telegraph: Red sigil; if you MOVE when it expires it roots you.
responses: Stop moving (safe spot) until it fades.
notes: The harder of the two curses.

sections.title: Reward Claim Flow — Gembloom Skull to +30 Spirit
paragraphs: After the center Ritual, kill the King. The Gembloom Skull drops on the ground (often near / behind the central altar, easy to miss).
Pick it up, then RIGHT-CLICK it in your inventory. The +30 maximum Spirit is applied only on use — the kill does not grant it automatically.
bullets: Gembloom Skull drops (check behind the altar).
Right-click the Skull in inventory -> +30 Spirit.
One-time; Spirit can be reserved by Persistent Skills.

rewards.label: Gembloom Skull
notes: Grants +30 to maximum Spirit. Right-click to use. One-time.

rewards.label: +30 Maximum Spirit
notes: Applied only after right-clicking the Skull, not on kill.

items.label: Chaos resistance
items.why: Ritual curses and Insect Swarm deal Chaos DoT.
items.fix: Chaos rolls or a Chaos charm.

items.label: Movement
checks: A movement skill or flask of speed.
items.why: The curses force you to keep moving or stop precisely.

items.label: Inventory space
checks: A free slot for the Skull.
items.why: The Skull drops on the ground.
items.fix: Free a slot before the kill.

items.label: Persistent Skill check
items.why: 0/30 after use may just be reservation, not a bug.
items.fix: Check the Spirit UI after use.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: The curse mechanics decide the fight. Ritual of Dance wants you moving; Ritual of Meditation wants you still. Reading the sigil color (purple = move, red = stop) is the core skill.
The second form is more mobile and projects more, so ranged kits have an easier time; melee must respect the Blood Pools and the brief untargetable transform.
bullets: Purple sigil = keep moving; red sigil = stop.
Ranged kites the second form comfortably.
Melee: punish after the slam, avoid Blood Pools.
Clear the cultist wave before the King.

entries.question: Gembloom Skull didn't drop / is hard to pick up
summary: Multiple players report the green quest item being hard to target at the altar, or unlootable; one fix was moving around the altar until the skull popped up.
editorialAnalysis: The Skull drops at the central altar and is easy to miss, especially on controller. It is a one-time drop.
officialAnswer: Pick up the Gembloom Skull after the kill; it is a one-time quest drop.

entries.question: Spirit shows 0/30 after using the Skull
summary: A player saw 0/30 and thought the Skull failed; the cause was a Persistent Skill reserving exactly 30 Spirit.
editorialAnalysis: 0/30 is the reserved pool, not a bug. The maximum Spirit cap did rise; check the base value, not the reserved amount.
officialAnswer: Check whether a Persistent Skill is reserving your Spirit.

directAnswer: You have an outer Ritual left. Complete all 3 outer Rituals; the black veil lifts only after the third.

problems.symptom: I killed the King but Spirit didn't rise
directAnswer: Pick up the Gembloom Skull AND right-click it. The kill does not apply Spirit. Also check Persistent Skill reservation (0/30 is not a bug).

problems.symptom: The Skull is nowhere on the ground
directAnswer: It drops near / behind the central altar. Circle the altar — on controller it can be a tiny, hard-to-target pickup.
checks: Did you check behind the altar?
